title: Conair tool dead
shortDescription: No power LED, no heat or airflow.
fullDescription:
Conair tools include an in-line ALCI/GFCI plug. Most often the GFCI has tripped — press the Reset button on the plug. Otherwise the cord may be damaged at the strain relief.

A tripped ALCI does not always have a visible indicator.

fixSteps.title: Press Reset on plug
fixSteps.instruction: Find Test/Reset on plug; press Reset.

fixSteps.title: Replace if cord damaged
fixSteps.instruction: Frayed cord = retire tool, no field repair.

faq.a: Appliance Leakage Current Interrupter — like GFCI for personal-care tools.

title: Bathroom GFCI trips when plugged in
fullDescription:
If the bathroom GFCI trips immediately on plug-in, the tool has a leak path — usually moisture or a heater shorted to chassis. Drying may help condensation cases; permanent shorts mean retire.

Do not bypass the GFCI.
symptoms: Other devices fine on same outlet

fixSteps.title: Dry 24 hours
fixSteps.instruction: Place in dry warm room overnight.

fixSteps.title: Test on non-bathroom outlet
fixSteps.instruction: If still trips that GFCI, internal short.

title: Conair dryer airflow weak
fullDescription:
Conair InfinitiPro and similar use a metal mesh rear filter that clogs with lint. Twist counter-clockwise to remove and rinse.

If airflow stays weak, motor brushes are worn.

fixSteps.title: Replace tool if no improvement
fixSteps.instruction: Brush motor at end of life.

videoSearchQuery: Conair dryer weak airflow filter clean

faq.a: Mesh filter yes; never the body.

title: Burning plastic smell from dryer
shortDescription: Hair on heater coils or motor brush burning.
fullDescription:
Burning smell signals hair stuck to the heater nichrome coils or worn motor brushes. First case clears after burning off; second case is fire risk.

If smell persists past 30 seconds, retire tool.

fixSteps.title: Turn off and inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug; look down nozzle for hair on coils.

fixSteps.title: Test in well-vented area
fixSteps.instruction: If smell persists past 30s on cool, retire.

faq.a: Only if smell clears after first 30 seconds.

title: Digital flat iron display flashing
fullDescription:
Conair digital flat irons flash the temperature display when actual plate reading deviates from setpoint by >30°C. Often plate buildup insulating thermistor.

Cool, clean plates, retest.

faq.a: Hair product polymerises on heat; clean every 2 weeks.

title: Curl Secret won't release
fullDescription:
Conair Curl Secret 2 has a tangle sensor that beeps and shows red when hair is caught. Open the chamber and gently free hair.

Do not pull — the heater can be displaced.

fixSteps.title: Press tangle release
fixSteps.instruction: Press release on side; chamber opens slowly.

fixSteps.title: Free hair
fixSteps.instruction: Gently unwind hair from chamber rod.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and on; light clears.

whenToCallPro: If chamber damaged from forced opening.
videoSearchQuery: Conair Curl Secret hair tangle release

faq.a: Section hair smaller and feed only the tip.

title: Conair clipper not cutting
fullDescription:
Conair clippers need oil every few uses. Without oil the blades skip and pull. Misalignment also causes pulling — top blade should sit 0.5mm behind bottom blade tip.

Align and oil.

fixSteps.title: Realign blade
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen 2 screws, set top blade 0.5mm back, retighten.

faq.a: No — only clipper oil; WD-40 dries and gums.

title: Conair cordless trimmer dead battery
fullDescription:
Conair cordless trimmers use NiMH or Li-ion. Verify adapter (varies 5V to 12V), then leave on charge 24h to wake protect circuit.

If still dead, NiMH cells often unrecoverable past 3 years.

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter polarity
fixSteps.instruction: Match printed voltage and tip polarity.

fixSteps.title: Replace tool if dead
fixSteps.instruction: NiMH cells past 3 years rarely recover.

faq.a: Yes possible — but soldering risk often exceeds new tool cost.

title: Conair tool shuts off itself
fullDescription:
Most Conair styling tools auto-shutoff at 60 minutes. Premature shutoff is the thermal safety reacting to a clogged filter.

Clean and retry.

title: Conair turbo steamer no steam
fullDescription:
Conair fabric steamers will heat but produce no steam if the water tank is empty, the boiler is heavily scaled, or the pump tube is kinked.

Descale with vinegar.

title: AFS jam
fullDescription: AutoFold System stuck. Common diagnostic on Conair hair tool. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean charging contacts or ports with soft cloth.

whenToCallPro: If reset/charge doesn't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most personal care devices have 1-2 year warranty.
Cleaning and reset usually fix common issues.
